title: Nullifier state check
instructions: Process both attempts in order to observe how a local nullifier set prevents a double vote. This is an educational simulation, not a blockchain transaction.
successCriteria: Process the first accepted attempt and then the second rejected attempt with the same masked nullifier.

survey.title: Community pulse poll
survey.question: Which privacy property should this anonymous vote preserve?

options.label: Count the vote without exposing the voter
Publish the voter's identity with the vote

attempts.title: First anonymous vote
attempts.description: The anonymous poll receives the selected vote with a masked nullifier that is not registered locally.
attempts.reason: member(nullifier) -> false. The masked nullifier is not present, so the vote is accepted and registered locally.

attempts.title: Resent anonymous vote
attempts.description: The same selected vote and masked nullifier are sent again.
attempts.reason: member(nullifier) -> true. The same masked nullifier is already registered, so the repeated vote is rejected locally.
